prompt: Firms want to give customers a discount on an invoice. Add an optional `discount` to `createInvoice`: a percentage from 0 to 100, applied to the invoice subtotal before tax. A discount outside that range must be rejected. `invoiceTotal` has to reflect it.
clarification: The discount is a whole-invoice percentage, never per item. Reject with a ValidationError. An invoice without discount behaves exactly as today.
